author: AnticlimacticLifeTrajectory
title: 10/10, No complaints. Genuinely a great app.
content:
I don't write app reviews but I want to give this game credit where credit is due. 

This game has a few modes, one of an increasing level of complexity and one called "classic." With classic I can zone out, place blocks on my own time (no pressure to get something done before a timer runs out.) It's relaxing and I can apply as much mental energy as I want. I like match three and other simple puzzle games but my go to, bejeweled sold out and the app is now unbearable to use. Other ones like Candy crush, Royal match, and Homescapes are money grabs.

Another mode increases the difficulty as you continue which is nice when I'm in the mood. 

One of the things that sets this game apart from so many other puzzle games is that there are no in app purchases, no high-pressure competitions between other players that push the user to play when they don't want to-there is just a leaderboard you can participate in if you want, similar to an old school arcade game.

Sometimes after you lose a level it forces and add to play, but if you just close the app then reopen it you go right back to where you were.

It does ask me to fill out a review after each level but it is just one box and you can exit out of it. I am curious to see if by posting my review that box will stop showing.

The last thing I will say is that if you like match three games without the competition, check out the game mundus, impossible universe. It's my other favorite puzzle game. :)

title: Too Many Long, Unskippable Ads

This game would be so much better if it didn’t interrupt your gameplay with long ads that cannot be skipped. Even if I accept the lame excuse that “we need ads to keep the game free,” there is no excuse for having ads that you cannot skip! Having full ads for gaining rewards is one thing, which makes sense and I can accept that. I play plenty of games with those kind of ad rewards. But having full ads that you can’t skip when you win or lose the game is ridiculous! And others are correct when they say there is no “no ads” option for purchase. 

Bottom line: Don’t believe the glowing reviews. This game is more ads than the actual game!
